summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing a weekly update on the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme. Between August 31 and September 4, 2026, the company repurchased 700,000 own shares at an average price of NOK 400.9647 per share, for a total transaction value of NOK 280,675,298.20. The tranche was announced on July 22, 2026, and runs through October 26, 2026. Following these transactions, Equinor holds 18,803,431 own shares, representing 0.79% of its share capital, including shares under its share savings programme. This is a routine capital return, not a tender offer or special situation.
